title: Scrimmage startup report, version 1
description: What a service process answers the runner's signed probe with: how it was started and what its gates found before any run. It holds no token, no plan and nothing of a run.

sdk.description: The version of scrimmage in the service.

python.description: The service's Python, as `sys.version` gives it.

executable.description: The path of the service's Python, with any secret in it removed.

mode.description: How the SDK runs in this process.

gates.description: The entry gates installed in this process, such as `asgi` for uvicorn and `starlette`.

libraries.description: Each gated library the service has imported, and its version.

chained_sitecustomize.description: True when the sitecustomize Python loaded is not Scrimmage's, as when the service has one of its own earlier on its path.

tools.description: The names the model sees for the tools SCRIMMAGE_TOOLS names, sorted.

notices.description: Notices a gate gave with no run open, such as a library too new or missing what a gate needs.

server_time.description: The service's clock when it answered, in seconds since the epoch.

notice.description: One notice given with no run.

library.description: The library it is about, or `scrimmage`.

message.description: What it says, as stderr printed it.
